arxiv-2007-09272.creator: J. Antonio García, D. Gutiérrez-Ruiz, R. Abraham Sánchez-Isidro Departamento de Física de Altas Energías, Instituto de Ciencias NuclearesUniversidad Nacional Autónoma de México,Apartado Postal 70-543, Ciudad de México, 04510, México
arxiv-2007-09272.description: Abstract The aim of this paper is to present a new approach to construct constants of motion associated with scaling symmetries of dynamical systems. Scaling maps could be symmetries of the equations of motion but not of its associated Lagrangian action.

arxiv-2102-00705.title: sharp interface limit for compressible non-isentropic phase-field model
arxiv-2102-00705.creator: Yazhou Chen, Qiaolin He, Xiaoding Shi, Xiaoping Wang
arxiv-2102-00705.description: Abstract . In this paper, the sharp interface limit for the compressible non-isentropic Navier-Stokes/Allen-Cahn system is derived by the method of matched asymptotic expansion. We show that the leading order problem satisfies the compressible Navier-Stokes equations with the interface being a free boundary. We discuss two cases in terms of different phase field diffusion coefficients.

arxiv-2107-03240.title: Infrared photons and asymptotic symmetries
arxiv-2107-03240.creator: Zhengwen Liu
arxiv-2107-03240.description: Abstract DESY-21-102 Abstract S-matrix elements exhibit universal factorization when multiple infrared photons are emitted in scattering processes. We explicitly show that the leading soft factorization of tree-level amplitudes with the emission of any number of soft photons can be interpreted as the Ward identity of the asymptotic symmetry of gauge theory.

arxiv-2206-08294.title: Mixing time and expansion of non-negatively curved Markov chains
arxiv-2206-08294.creator: Florentin Münch & Justin Salez
arxiv-2206-08294.description: Abstract We establish three remarkable consequences of non-negative curvature for sparse Markov chains. First, their conductance decreases logarithmically with the number of states. Second, their displacement is at least diffusive until the mixing time. Third, they never exhibit the cutoff phenomenon. The first result provides a nearly sharp quantitative answer to a classical question of Ollivier, Milman & Naor.

arxiv-2303-14299.title: Systematic analysis of (multi)strange hadron 𝐩 𝐭 \bf p_{t} spectra from small collision systems at the large hadron collider Preprint: version 2.0
arxiv-2303-14299.creator: Thomas A. Trainor
arxiv-2303-14299.description: Abstract Small collision systems, e.g. p p - p p and p p -Pb collisions, comprise a potential reference for more-central A-A collisions with regard to production (or not) of a thermalized quark-gluon plasma (QGP). Small systems with low particle densities should evolve according to simple QCD mechanisms including projectile-nucleon dissociation and dijet production.

arxiv-2505-13449.title: Modelling Real-time Systems with Bigraphs
arxiv-2505-13449.creator: Maram Albalwe, Blair Archibald Michele Sevegnani
arxiv-2505-13449.description: Abstract Bigraphical Reactive Systems (BRSs) are a graph-rewriting formalism describing systems evolving in two dimensions: spatially, e.g. a person in a room, and non-spatially, e.g. mobile phones communicating regardless of location. Despite use in domains including communication protocols, agent programming, biology, and security, there is no support for real-time systems.

pmc-13572970.description: Parental feeding practices have been associated with young children's vegetable consumption cross‐sectionally, but there is limited longitudinal evidence that measures multiple feeding practices at multiple time points with a robust dietary outcome measure. uslaw-usc-t16-s539.title: 16 U.S.C. § 539 — Additions to existing national forests; administration
uslaw-usc-t16-s539.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s539.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 2 (National Forests); Subchapter I (Establishment And Administration). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The following units of the National Forest System are hereby expanded: (1) Chugach National Forest by the addition of four areas, Nellie Juan, College Fjord, Copper/Rude River, and Controller Bay, containing approximately one million nine hundred thousand acres of public land.
